AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-backend#658 @ 08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

Independent first full **T4** review; **A/B/C 0/3/2**. I read the complete 26-file diff, the body and the existing Opus verdict; the auth/tenancy, canonical-attach, new RLS and CI-workflow changes justify T4 as declared. [Candidate and contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658), [Opus findings](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5964473420).

### B-658-1 — team attribution is bypassed

Agree with the existing ID: new create stores `coach_id: actor.id` and no inviter, whereas legacy create resolves an active team sub-coach to the head coach and preserves `invited_by_user_id`; a team sub-coach is role `coach`, so the route guard does not exclude them. This attaches new clients outside the head tenant and hides their codes/counts from that head. My independent real-service probe with an active synthetic team assignment produces `coach_id: synthetic-sub`, `invited_by_user_id: null`, not the head tenant. [New create](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/coach-code-tools.service.ts#L255-L277), [existing attribution rule](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/invite-codes.service.ts#L395-L410), [guarded route](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/coach-code-tools.controller.ts).

Reuse canonical effective-coach/inviter attribution and define sub-coach read/mutation scope, or explicitly refuse these tools for active team sub-coaches until supported; test stored attribution, actual attach, head visibility and non-owner mutation denial. [Existing canonical team behavior](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/invite-codes.service.ts).

### B-658-6 — code publication precedes package validation/binding

This narrows and raises Opus's bundled C-658-5 concurrency item: create commits an active, unbound InviteCode first, then awaits `setBinding`; both initial same-key replay and the P2002 loser return that row without waiting for the package decision, and list/attach can also observe it. The comment “never returned to anyone” is false under that ordering. My staged actual-service test pauses binding, retries the same prepaid request, receives success with `package: null`/`grant_mode: none`, then releases a package refusal: the original request fails and deletes the already-returned code. This is a successful QR for a nonexistent or incorrectly unbound product, not merely optional malformed-key handling. [Replay, insert and cleanup ordering](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/coach-code-tools.service.ts#L230-L319), [separate package validation/write](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-grant/invite-grant.service.ts#L287-L356), [existing bundled observation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658#issuecomment-5964473420).

Validate and publish the complete binding atomically with the code/idempotency outcome, reusing the grant rules transactionally; alternatively a durable pending state must be unredeemable/unlistable and replays must await or return a stable pending/refusal outcome. Add concurrent create/replay/list/attach tests for both successful and failed binding, asserting no observer sees an active partial code. [Affected create implementation](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/coach-code-tools.service.ts#L217-L343).

### B-658-7 — permanent coach-link rotation is not replay-safe

The `coach-link` branch always rotates the current profile and returns `replayed: false`; unlike row rotation, neither the endpoint nor service accepts an expected old generation or persisted rotation key. Two identical sequential requests mint two successors: the second archives/revokes the QR returned by the first. My actual-service probe reproduces different successor codes and `firstNowRevoked: true` with grace zero. The profile CAS prevents one stale transaction overwriting another, but cannot identify a network retry; P2002 retry can also advance against a newer current code. [Special branch versus row replay handling](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/coach-code-tools.service.ts#L348-L389), [profile rotation loop](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/invite-codes.service.ts#L627-L688), [promised retry behavior](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658).

Persist a per-coach rotation idempotency result or require the observed old generation and return its existing successor; identical retries must return the first successor without changing its lifecycle, while distinct intentional rotations must still work. Cover sequential timeout retry and overlapping requests, grace zero and nonzero, with the real migration-backed service in CI. [Rotation API](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/coach-code-tools.controller.ts), [current regression scope](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/test/coach-code-tools.service.spec.ts).

### Optional / composition notes

- **C-658-2 carried integration seam:** when #608 is composed, classify and erase both InviteRedemption User relations in the manifest; tombstoning does not invoke FK cascades. This is an explicit second-landing requirement, not a claim that #608 already contains this new table. [Schema and migration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/tree/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/prisma), [declared deletion dependency](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658).
- **C-658-8 — leak signal depends on display-window length:** `signups(days)` passes only the requested display counts to `isUnusualToday`, which averages at most those prior rows; `days=1` has no prior baseline and treats three signups as unusual even after a busy week. Fetch a separate seven-local-day baseline independently of the requested display window and test that changing `days` does not change today's signal. [Helper and query](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/src/invite-codes/coach-code-tools.service.ts), [trailing-seven-day contract](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658).

### Verified evidence / limits

Five targeted candidate suites pass **64/64** tests; three added offline real-service adversarial probes fail on the boundaries above (22 inherited tests deliberately filtered, not presented as executions). Evidence is retained at `ops/aud-sol-114b/658-*`; only synthetic identities and doubles were used, with no hosted database or customer mutation. [Candidate suites](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/tree/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/test).

All 11 required checks are green at the exact head, including schema parity, CodeQL, whole-graph npm audit and community-live-tests; the CI workflow delta adds one live spec path without deleting or weakening existing gates. Additive migration has reversible down SQL, forced ledger RLS, coach/owner reads, service-only writes and restrictive anonymous denial; the ledger insert is inside the attach transaction and normal replay/refusal paths do not add rows. [Exact-head checks](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/pull/658/checks), [workflow](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/.github/workflows/ci.yml), [migration](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/blob/08534e17c686602415f0836abc66db0182aeea3f/prisma/migrations/20270302000000_coach_code_tools/migration.sql).

No push, merge, dispatch, production action or candidate-source edit.
